answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 18800 Country: India Title: Plz confirm if some one ask for divorce their wive on pressure , and if some one say single time divorce to their wive and the person who pressurise him for divorce feel relax , plz keep light on this matter. Question: Assalam alayequm Plz confirm if some one ask for divorce their wive on pressure , and if some one say single time divorce to their wive and the person who pressurise him for divorce feel relax , plz keep light on this matter. Answer ID: 18800 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 296/248/D=1431) If one gave one talaq verbally, though due to pressure from someone, it will take place. If he used the word of ?talaq?, it will be considered revocable Talaq ( raj?i ) i.e. the husband can take her back within iddah period, but once the iddah is over, he has to perform a new Nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
